en.headline: Chief Executive inspects Wan Chai polling station ahead of Election Committee vote
en.dek: John Lee visited Harbour Road Sports Centre this afternoon and urged eligible voters to cast ballots tomorrow in the contest for 723 seats.
body: Chief Executive John Lee inspected a polling station in Wan Chai this afternoon ahead of Sunday's Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections.

Accompanied by Secretary for Constitutional and Mainland Affairs Erick Tsang and Electoral Affairs Commission Chairman Barnabas Fung, Lee visited the ordinary polling station at Harbour Road Sports Centre to review the layout and final preparations and to encourage staff.

Lee said the Election Committee's composition is broadly representative and forms an important part of Hong Kong's electoral system. He noted that 31 contested subsectors will see 856 candidates compete for 723 seats, chosen by about 5,700 voters.

He called on eligible voters to turn out tomorrow and elect their preferred representatives, and encouraged the public to follow the election and care about Hong Kong's future development. Voting runs from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. at five ordinary polling stations.

zh.headline: 行政長官視察灣仔票站 選委會選舉明日舉行
zh.dek: 李家超今午到港灣道體育館了解準備情況，呼籲合資格投票人明日踴躍投票，選出723名委員。
body: 行政長官李家超今午視察灣仔一間投票站，為明日舉行的選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉作準備。
李家超在政制及內地事務局局長曾國衞及選舉管理委員會主席陸啟康陪同下，到訪港灣道體育館的一般投票站，了解場地佈置及最後準備情況，並為工作人員打氣。
李家超表示，選委會組成具廣泛代表性，是香港選舉制度的重要組成部分。今次有31個需要競逐的界別分組，由約5700名投票人選出723名委員。
他呼籲合資格投票人明日踴躍投票，選出心儀代表加入選委會，並鼓勵市民留意選舉情況，共同關心香港未來發展。五個一般投票站投票時間為上午九時至下午六時。
